text.null_void_beam_desc: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.
text.tech_adaptive_bureaucracy_desc: The progress we make calls for a new, nimbler form of administration that may aid rather than hinder us in our pursuits.
text.tech_adaptive_combat_algorithms_desc: Organics often fight using illogical and unpredictable tactics that can be difficult to effectively counter. Adaptive tactics and new, more maneuverable warforms should provide a decisive advantage.
text.tech_advanced_industrial_storm_protectio: By consolidating local weather control systems, planetary weather patterns can be manipulated to significantly reduce most of the cosmic storms' harmful effects on production.
text.tech_advanced_metallurgy_1_desc: The widespread use of advanced ceramics in industry can improve metallurgical yields.
text.tech_advanced_metallurgy_2_desc: By replacing antiquated ceramo-metal equipment with cutting edge technology, we can run our forges hotter and longer, increasing production.
text.tech_advanced_storm_manipulation_desc: Continued study into astrometeorology grants us the power to more precisely bend and manipulate Cosmic Storms to our own needs.
text.tech_afterburners_1_desc: These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.
text.tech_afterburners_2_desc: This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.
text.tech_akx_worm_1_desc: The universe tends irresistibly onwards and downwards. That tendency cannot be reversed... but it can be subverted, for a price.
text.tech_akx_worm_2_desc: A set of social protocols based on paradoxical intuition, and on love. When we know the System of the Loop, we learn that we can influence by receiving instructions, as well as giving them.
text.tech_akx_worm_3_desc: When a temporal paradox becomes tangled, a kind of consciousness arises, with its own needs, its own desires. This is what has occurred with the consciousness that some call the Worm-in-Waiting. If we can align ourselves with that consciousness, we might just achieve a kind of immortality.
text.tech_alien_cloning_desc: In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the Genetic Material collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.
text.tech_alien_life_studies_desc: Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.
text.tech_alien_topography_desc: Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies.
text.tech_alloy_fossilization_desc: By exposing biological material to simulated chthonian-level radiation, we can fossilize cellular structures into usable metallic alloys.
text.tech_alloys_1_desc: Solid holographic casts can alter their shapes at a moment's notice, speeding up alloy production.
text.tech_alloys_2_desc: Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.
text.tech_amoeba_strike_craft_1_desc: By altering the breeding process of Space Amoebas, we can program their symbiotic flagella to act as organic strike craft for our navy.
text.tech_antimatter_power_desc: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.
text.tech_arc_emitter_1_desc: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.
text.tech_arc_emitter_2_desc: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.
text.tech_arcane_deciphering_desc: Various artifacts and technologies functioning by arcane means that cannot be understood or replicated... at least not by conventional science as it is known to us.
text.tech_archaeo_detection_scrambler_desc: Ping repeaters and optic diffusers with the right wavelengths can produce destructive interference and effectively scramble hostile targeting systems.
text.tech_archaeo_lasers_desc: This high energy weapon causes brutal micro collapsing events on impact, generating tremendous heat and force inside its targets armor.
text.tech_archaeo_mass_accelerator_desc: This cannon fires a barrage of ancient miniscule ionized spheres that charge upon contact with most force fields, giving them high levels of shield penetration. Any theory that these spheres could have been used for jewelry purposes were dismissed when a critical incident melted an entire laboratory.
text.tech_archaeo_mass_drivers_desc: These cannons of gargantuan size deliver relatively slow but devastating projectiles, and can fire pretty much anything, from scrap metal, to asteroid chunks.
text.tech_archaeo_missiles_desc: Particle charges, once stabilized thanks to ancient technology, allow us to create swarms of tiny missiles that still carry a respectable payload, and should be able to overwhelm most point-defense systems.
text.tech_archaeo_overcharger_desc: Supercharging shields can be done safely thanks to ancient stabilizer coils and dampeners. In addition to the production of a stronger force field, this also has the added benefit of outright vaporizing certain incoming projectiles.
text.tech_archaeo_pk_devolving_beam_desc: A colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state. We estimate that with additional tuning, it might also be used to wipe clean memory banks and disable robotic units.
text.tech_archaeo_point_defence_desc: When it comes to tracking and shooting down missiles, these antique batteries are the best of the best, making use of a predictive algorithm written in long forgotten code to weave a fiery defensive web.
text.tech_archaeo_rampart_desc: Defense platforms are a cost effective way to ensure our safety, but they need to be monitored from an operation center. Fortifying our Starbase to ensure its survivability in the event of an attack, and maximizing our capacity to network independent orbital defenses would give us more time to dispatch reinforcements.
text.tech_archaeo_refinery_desc: This millennia-old processing equipment has an efficiency rate above 100%. Its functioning remains alien, but its production gains are substantial.
text.tech_archaeo_strike_crafts_desc: These high velocity drones have been equipped with antique mining lasers that virtually ignore any plating protecting their target. A tech too good to be wasted on astro mining.
text.tech_archaeo_titan_beam_desc: Tremendous medium range firepower will enable our titans to break through enemy lines. These ancient cannons were once the foundation upon which a galactic empire was built.
text.tech_archaeoarmor_desc: Ionized plates of armor can carry a reactive charge to alleviate the energy of impacts, using magnetic repulsion and field projection principles.
text.tech_archaeoshield_desc: Projected farther than regular shields, the suspension field technology uses ancient artifacts to slow time at the point of impact to afford the shields a longer opportunity to dispel the incoming attack's energy.
text.tech_archaeostudies_desc: This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars. With a bit of work, their legacies could secure our future.
text.tech_archaeostudies_wilderness_desc: This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars. With a bit of work, their legacies could secure our future.
text.tech_archeology_lab_ancrel_desc: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.
text.tech_archeology_lab_desc: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.
text.tech_arkship_construction_desc: Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.
text.tech_arkship_exodus_jump_desc: The Exodus Coordinator is still largely a prototype that will one day enable us to cross to different galaxies in the blink of an eye.
text.tech_arkship_planetary_refinery_desc: Smaller celestial bodies can be crushed and processed in these enormous gears, providing us with a bounty of materials.
text.tech_arkship_stellar_igniter_desc: A dark matter injection system capable of triggering stellar-scale fusion events. It has no safe setting.
text.tech_arkship_system_scanner_desc: The void speaks, and for those who know to listen, it whispers the secrets of the countless worlds in its embrace.
text.tech_arkship_tier_2_desc: Refined structural design and improved drive systems allow for a new generation of Arkships: carrying more of who we are, further than we have ever gone.
text.tech_arkship_tier_3_desc: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.
text.tech_armor_hardeners_1_desc: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.
text.tech_armor_hardeners_2_desc: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.
text.tech_artificial_moral_codes_desc: It is circumstance that dictates what is moral. Define the circumstances, and ethics is like clay in your hands.
text.tech_ascension_theory_desc: Our history is a repeating cycle of dramatic technological, political, and cultural leaps; these leaps are often preceded by periods of upheaval and followed by times of relative stability. By identifying the core, recurring premises of these leaps, we may be able to effectively short-circuit the cycle for our own benefit.
text.tech_assault_armies_desc: The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.
text.tech_assembly_pattern_desc: Rapid iteration in construction simulations determines the optimal component assembly patterns for each building project ahead of time.
text.tech_assisted_detection_desc: Coupling detection arrays with the computers onboard our science vessels can vastly increase their scanning resolution.
text.tech_asteroidal_carapace_desc: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.
text.tech_astral_harvesting_desc: The harvesting of torn astral fabric along the scars of rifts in space and time is made possible with delicate modifications to our research stations.
text.tech_atmospheric_orbital_mechanics_desc: Due to our vast experience operating observation stations in orbit of pre-FTL worlds, we have discovered slight optimizations. By implementing them empire-wide, we can drastically reduce the maintenance our stations require.
text.tech_aura_intensification_desc: Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's Psionic Auras can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foes.
text.tech_aura_resonation_desc: There is a way to project Psionic Auras beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an Psionic Projector, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.
text.tech_autocannons_1_desc: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.
text.tech_autocannons_2_desc: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.
text.tech_autocannons_3_desc: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.
text.tech_autocurating_vault_desc: Continuous, asynchronous analysis of disparate data sets allows for the accurate modeling of hitherto-unpredictable fluctuations in social currents.
text.tech_automated_exploration_desc: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.
text.tech_autonomous_agents_desc: Semi-independent units have proved critical to the success of the greater whole.
text.tech_auxiliary_fire_control_desc: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.
text.tech_basic_health_desc: A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. Sometimes, however, both are needed.
text.tech_basic_industry_desc: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.
text.tech_basic_science_lab_2_desc: As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.
text.tech_basic_science_lab_3_desc: To expand our knowledge base, we must consider all levels of existence. A new realm of science awaits us!
text.tech_battleship_build_speed_desc: Establishing new standards for how we design and construct massive battleships greatly improves the speed at which they can be assembled.
text.tech_battleship_hull_1_desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable battleships.
text.tech_battleship_hull_2_desc: The latest generation of battleship hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
text.tech_battleships_desc: The largest of the standard military vessels, Battleships are traditionally heavily armored and sport several gun batteries.
text.tech_binary_motivators_desc: These advanced motivators are both smaller and lighter than previous versions, allowing robotic units to allocate additional space for subsystems.
text.tech_bio_autocannons_1_desc: Sharper quills, fired at increased rates, deliver devastating volleys to overwhelm shields and shred hulls.
text.tech_bio_autocannons_2_desc: Refined biological quills fire with superior velocity to pierce through even hardened defenses.
text.tech_bio_autocannons_3_desc: Hyper-dense quills can be fired at a blistering pace eviscerating shields and carving through heavily armored targets with ease.
text.tech_bio_hyper_drive_1_desc: Like the strands of a spider web, the extra-dimensional realm of hyperspace runs between the gravity wells of most stars. Faster than light travel is theoretically possible along these hyperlanes.
text.tech_bio_hyper_drive_2_desc: We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.
text.tech_bio_hyper_drive_3_desc: A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing subspace slipstreams. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.
text.tech_bio_jump_drive_1_desc: The revolutionary Jump Organ manipulates the local space-time continuum at the quantum level, restructuring it to match the target destination. This process enables ships to appear to "jump" near-instantaneously between systems.
text.tech_bio_nanite_autocannon_desc: The pinnacle of quill weaponry is capable of saturating battlefields with relentless and devastating precision-guided projectiles.
text.tech_bio_plasma_1_desc: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor and hull.
text.tech_bio_plasma_2_desc: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.
text.tech_bio_plasma_3_desc: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.
text.tech_bio_psi_jump_drive_1_desc: The Psi Jump Organ acts as a focus point for the the psionic potential of the ship and crew to warp the local space-time continuum, eliminating the distance between the point of origin and the destination. Supposedly.
text.tech_bio_reactor_2_desc: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate, improvements in waste collection allows harvesting of useful gaseous by-products.
text.tech_bio_reactor_desc: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate.
text.tech_bio_swarmer_missiles_1_desc: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.
text.tech_bio_swarmer_missiles_2_desc: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.
text.tech_biomechanics_desc: Millions of years of organic evolution will sometimes, through sheer persistence, produce elegant solutions that can also be applied to machine designs.
text.tech_bioship_thrusters_1_desc: Through a combination of muscles, fins, and chemical exhausts this ship is capable of sublight travel.
text.tech_bioship_thrusters_2_desc: An array of electrically charged organs accelerate ions to generate thrust.
text.tech_bioship_thrusters_3_desc: Further refinements of the electrical capabilities of the motor organs allow for greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
text.tech_bioship_thrusters_4_desc: Highly advanced fusion chambers grant this ship unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
text.tech_bioship_thrusters_5_desc: Embedded clusters of dark matter within the ship's tissues enable it to "swim" through space, moving in ways that defy conventional physics and our current understanding of propulsion.
text.tech_boarding_cables_desc: Repurposed small-caliber artillery that fire piercing hooks attached to resilient carbon fiber cables, perfect for immobilizing and boarding enemy ships.
text.tech_btc_1_desc:
A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter.

When the star detonates, ALL colonies, megastructures, and stations in the system are destroyed - including our own. All fleets in the system will go MIA. The Star-Eater itself is the only exception.
text.tech_capacity_boosters_desc: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.
text.tech_capital_productivity_1_desc: As our colonies become more developed, we can gain significant improvements to our throughput.
text.tech_capital_productivity_2_desc: Increased population density gives us an opportunity to further increase productivity.
text.tech_capital_productivity_3_desc: Continued advancements in technology allow our most developed planets to reach productivity levels unheard of in earlier times.
text.tech_centralized_command_desc: Creating dedicated headquarters for all levels of military operations shapes an efficient fleet, and lays a better foundation for future military training.
text.tech_civilian_arkship_desc: More than a vessel, the Civilian Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.
text.tech_climate_restoration_desc: By advancing our understanding of atmospheric transformation, we will be able to terraform even the most ecologically devastated worlds.
text.tech_cloaking_1_desc: A modified particle field allows our vessels to effectively 'hide' in open space. However, this comes at the cost of destabilizing other forms of energy shielding which would otherwise protect the ship.
text.tech_cloaking_2_desc: Advancements in rare crystal lensing technology have greatly improved cloaking efficiency.
text.tech_cloaking_3_desc: Typical cloaking technology can play havoc with a ship's more delicate instruments. However, these elite fields render such concerns obsolete.
text.tech_cloaking_dark_matter_desc: This device uses dark matter to warp space-time around the vessel, making it incredibly difficult to detect.
text.tech_cloaking_psi_desc: Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud. This allows the ship to remain undetected by all but the best sensor arrays, though what the crew may be forced to witness is better left unsaid.
text.tech_cloning_desc: Breakthroughs in enucleation and artificial womb technology allows for the mass-production of individuals based on a common genetic template.
text.tech_cold_fusion_power_desc: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.
text.tech_collective_self_desc: Finding aspects of the self within the group is natural and inevitable; eventually those shared aspects must be valued higher than individual identities.
text.tech_colonial_bureaucracy_desc: Local administrative developments allow for closer supervision of colonial affairs without excessively burdening central decision-making.
text.tech_colonial_centralization_desc: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.
text.tech_colonization_1_desc: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand colony ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.
text.tech_colonization_1_wilderness_desc: We turn our focus to calculating the resources and materials required to awaken new worlds, thereby readying our pioneer symbionts for their arduous voyages across the stars.
text.tech_colonization_2_desc: By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.
text.tech_colonization_3_desc: Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.
text.tech_colonization_4_desc: Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.
text.tech_colonization_5_desc: Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.
text.tech_colossus_desc: Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels. These immense, single-weapon platforms are capable of radically altering or obliterating entire worlds at the push of a button.
text.tech_combat_computers_1_desc: Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.
text.tech_combat_computers_2_desc: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
text.tech_combat_computers_3_desc: Running sapient AIs through high-intensity combat simulations yields valuable insight into potential optimizations for risk-evaluation techniques.
text.tech_combat_computers_autonomous_desc: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.
text.tech_combat_computers_bio_integration_de: We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in wide scale fleet combat.
text.tech_combat_training_desc: A more extensive training program for new recruits, including realistic combat scenarios, prepare them for the field.
text.tech_command_matrix_desc: Restructuring the chain of command and deciding what interdependencies are set between officers, make fleets more responsive and effective.
text.tech_compact_living_desc: While no one civilization has the perfect solution to the ever-expanding challenge of governing a growing nation, we have found a partial solution. After studying a multitude of species and governments, we have discovered an outstanding balance of flexibility and function.
text.tech_consecration_fields_desc: Through our understanding of physics and field manipulation, our holy places shall we seen and felt by all.
text.tech_construction_templates_desc: Standardized pre-fab templates massively reduce on-site facility construction times.
text.tech_consumer_good_refinement_1_desc: Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.
text.tech_consumer_good_refinement_2_desc: Using advanced AIs, we can reliably predict consumer demand before it exists.
text.tech_containment_vessel_desc: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of Space Fauna.
text.tech_controlled_mutations_2_desc: We can go further. Advanced manipulation of Space Fauna genetics allows for integrating a wider variety of specialized components.
text.tech_controlled_mutations_desc: We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.
text.tech_corvette_build_speed_desc: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of corvettes greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
text.tech_corvette_hull_1_desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable corvettes.
text.tech_corvette_hull_2_desc: The latest generation of corvette hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
text.tech_corvettes_desc: The FTL breakthrough allowed early attempts to adapt traditional surface-to-space shuttle frames to military applications to finally create relatively small, fast, and maneuverable vessels with limited firepower.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_FE_titan_desc: These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_battlecruiser_desc: Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_1_desc: The radical shift in perspective required to comprehend the infinite layers of reality challenges even our most brilliant minds.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_2_desc: Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_3_desc: Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_4_desc: Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_5_desc:
Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey.

Fallen Empires will try to stop us!
text.tech_cosmogenesis_escort_desc: A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_harbinger_desc: These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_mauler_desc: Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_stinger_desc: Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_thesis_desc: By making further alterations to reality's rules, we can better monitor its reactions. At this scale, the effects are still difficult to predict, and could affect the entire galaxy.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_weaver_desc: Equipped with support weapon arrays that outstrip its visible anatomy, the Quandary Weaver rewrites spatial norms. Alone, it can shift the momentum of entire battles.
text.tech_cosmogenesis_world_desc: Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.
text.tech_covenant_composer_desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
text.tech_covenant_cradle_desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
text.tech_covenant_eater_desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
text.tech_covenant_instrument_desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
text.tech_covenant_whisperers_desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
text.tech_critter_feeder_desc: Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna.
text.tech_cruiser_build_speed_desc: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of cruisers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
text.tech_cruiser_hull_1_desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable cruisers.
text.tech_cruiser_hull_2_desc: The latest generation of cruiser hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
text.tech_cruisers_desc: Originally devised as an experimental next-generation colony ship hull configuration, the design's ample hardpoints made it ideal for carrying heavy weapons ordnance.
text.tech_cryostasis_1_desc: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.
text.tech_cryostasis_1_wilderness_desc: By first incubating our new seedlings in the native soils of new colonies we can speed up the acclimatization process.
text.tech_cryostasis_2_desc: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.
text.tech_cryostasis_2_wilderness_desc: Permanently maintaining specialized seedlings capable of surviving all types of climates massively decreases the time it takes us to create new worlds.
text.tech_cryovault_desc: By harnessing the subthermal dynamics found in the environments of frozen worlds, we can create more hospitable living conditions in colder climates.
text.tech_crystal_armor_1_desc: By infusing armor plating with Crystalline matter we are able to further increase the durability of our ships' protective hulls.
text.tech_crystal_armor_2_desc: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.
text.tech_cultural_heritage_desc: An understanding of a shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future.
text.tech_curator_lab_desc: These shipboard lab facilities incorporate advanced technologies from the ancient Curator Order to further increase survey speeds.
text.tech_dangerous_wildlife_desc: Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.
text.tech_dark_matter_deflector_desc: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.
text.tech_dark_matter_detection_desc: Dark matter resonance chambers will significantly improve the performance of our detection arrays.
text.tech_dark_matter_power_core_desc: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.
text.tech_dark_matter_propulsion_desc: These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.
text.tech_decryption_1_desc: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.
text.tech_decryption_2_desc: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.
text.tech_decryption_3_desc: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.
text.tech_deep_sinkhole_desc: Many planets exhibit extensive subsurface voids. Subterranean exploration, exploitation, and construction techniques can greatly increase the habitable area of some worlds.
text.tech_deep_space_citadel_desc: A Deep Space Citadel is an armored Starbase designed for maximum defense within a stellar gravity well.
text.tech_defense_platform_hull_1_desc: A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.
text.tech_dense_jungle_desc: Thorough cataloging, gene sequencing, and computer modeling of exobotanical ecosystems, coupled with gene editing and dispersal mechanisms, will allow us to reshape alien plant communities to our liking.
text.tech_destroyer_build_speed_desc: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of destroyers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
text.tech_destroyer_hull_1_desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable destroyers.
text.tech_destroyer_hull_2_desc: The latest generation of destroyer hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
text.tech_destroyers_desc: While larger than Corvettes, Destroyer hull configurations still make for comparatively nimble gunboats.
text.tech_detection_array_desc: A high-powered suite of external sensors, capable of detecting cloaked fleets.
text.tech_disruptors_1_desc: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together. They are capable of passing through shields and armor to wreak havoc directly on enemy hull and crew.
text.tech_disruptors_2_desc: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.
text.tech_disruptors_3_desc: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.
text.tech_doctrine_fleet_size_1_desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
text.tech_doctrine_fleet_size_2_desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
text.tech_doctrine_fleet_size_3_desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
text.tech_doctrine_fleet_size_4_desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
text.tech_doctrine_fleet_size_5_desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
text.tech_doctrine_navy_size_1_desc: As extrasolar expeditions become more common, it is important to provide planetside relief for returning fleets.
text.tech_doctrine_navy_size_2_desc: A fleet does not run on zeal alone. To ensure steady access to critical supplies, we should organize our logistics corps into dedicated support vessels.
text.tech_doctrine_navy_size_3_desc: Amateurs talk about tactics. Professionals study logistics. By ensuring our fleets are regularly and efficiently supplied, we can increase the number of vessels we can effectively support.
text.tech_doctrine_navy_size_4_desc: By maintaining a professional corps of fleet liaisons, we can improve communications and the flow of orders throughout the chain of command.
text.tech_dragon_armor_desc: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.
text.tech_droid_workers_desc: Upgraded artificial units have an expanded movement range equal to that of most organics. Their neural processors have also been greatly improved.
text.tech_dyson_gun_desc: Allows us to shoot our energy stockpile at targeted systems
text.tech_dyson_sphere_desc: A Dyson Sphere fully envelops a given star, converting all solar output directly to  Energy Credits.
text.tech_dyson_swarm_desc: An array of interlinked satellites, the Dyson Swarm is designed to improve the output of stellar deposits.
text.tech_eco_simulation_desc: Farming techniques can be further refined through sophisticated computer simulations of different environments and weather patterns. This allows for more predictable crop yields.
text.tech_ecological_adaptation_desc: By adapting planetary ecosystems to large-scale environmental changes we can turn terraformation into a less disruptive process.
text.tech_effective_bureaucracy_desc: Improved algorithms for processing and organizing vast amounts of data has streamlined decision-making and information-sharing throughout the empire.
text.tech_embodied_dynamism_desc: Initiative and some measure of ambition must be promoted in our autonomous leader units, while still making certain that they do not stray too far from the directives of the core intelligence.
text.tech_encryption_1_desc: Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.
text.tech_encryption_2_desc: Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.
text.tech_encryption_3_desc: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.
text.tech_energy_lance_1_desc: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.
text.tech_energy_lance_2_desc: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.
text.tech_energy_torpedoes_1_desc: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.
text.tech_energy_torpedoes_2_desc: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.
text.tech_engineering_1_desc: Further breakthroughs in mechanical engineering required us to descend to the nanometric scale. We are now able to manipulate physical systems in never-before-seen ways.
text.tech_engineering_2_desc: Much as organic neurons reforge lost connections by means of axonal sprouting, these circuits are capable of self-overhaul. Even the simplest computing systems are now expected to evolve while in use.
text.tech_engineering_3_desc: The quantum mechanical properties of these materials hold the key to superposition states, a revolutionary development for both material and industrial science.
text.tech_enhanced_cryosleep_sedatives_desc: Sedatives based on a rare enzyme enable enhanced cryosleep, greatly improving organic species' tolerance of long-distance space travel.
text.tech_enigmatic_decoder_desc: While producing average results in standard tests, the accuracy of Enigmatic Decoder's prediction algorithms seemingly increases as the target's flight path grows more erratic.
text.tech_enigmatic_encoder_desc: The Enigmatic Encoder scrambles flight path data according to some indeterminable design before feeding it back to fleet command.
text.tech_epigenetic_triggers_desc: Advanced DNA methylation techniques allow for functionally significant alterations to be made to arbitrary genomes.
text.tech_executive_retreat_desc: A luxurious resort complex for high ranking corporate officers. Here they can sample the local culture in a high security environment.
text.tech_existential_campaigns_desc: When survival itself is at stake, the very concept of war loses its meaning. These campaigns are waged not for dominion, but to secure the continued existence of our civilization.
text.tech_exotic_gases_desc: Exotic Gas can be produced artificially, but it is a difficult process that requires advanced refinery equipment.
text.tech_experimental_subspace_navigation_de: Solitary Science Ships can break out of the naturally-occurring hyperlanes and attempt to navigate to known but otherwise unreachable destinations.
text.tech_extra_large_space_fauna_build_speed: Establishing new standards for the cloning and nurturing of Huge Space Fauna greatly improves the efficiency of the reproduction pipeline.
text.tech_extra_large_space_fauna_hull_1_desc: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Huge Space Fauna.
text.tech_extra_large_space_fauna_hull_2_desc: We have pushed the limits of Huge Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.
text.tech_extradimensional_weapon_1_desc: Applying 5th-dimensional energy manipulation principles on lower dimensional planes allows for the creation of powerful energy weapons.
text.tech_fe_administration_1_desc: Our administrative requirements will likewise expand as our mastery of advanced technology evolves. We must adeptly cater to the demands of our burgeoning empire.
text.tech_fe_administration_2_desc: Our technology now surpasses any administrative requirement. The expertise needed to seamlessly govern a galactic empire is firmly within our reach.
text.tech_fe_affluence_1_desc: This center anticipates and fulfills material desires using an advanced procurement algorithm, delivering satisfaction before the populace realizes their wants.
text.tech_fe_affluence_2_desc: This center effortlessly materializes the most outlandish desires at a moment's notice.
text.tech_fe_assembly_1_desc: An avant-garde assembly complex manned by expert Roboticists, this facility transcends conventional bounds, meticulously realizing the forefront of robotic innovation.
text.tech_fe_assembly_2_desc: A marvel in engineering, this facility's quantic assembly line uses entanglement converters to craft machine parts down to the most minute detail. Not a single atom is misplaced.
text.tech_fe_clinic_1_desc: Molecular-Revitalization Institutes delve deep into cellular intricacies to amplify the effectiveness of medical treatments, significantly improving the quality and longevity of the populations' health.
text.tech_fe_clinic_2_desc: The Bioregeneration Institute, at the pinnacle of medical technology, pioneers groundbreaking bio-regenerative therapies, continuously redefining the boundaries of life extension.
text.tech_fe_dome_1_desc: This floating city, propelled by state-of-the-art anti-gravity technology, provides an idyllic haven for its inhabitants.
text.tech_fe_dome_2_desc: Suspended by gravimetric nullification, these domes transcend physical limitations, while advanced life support systems seamlessly cater to inhabitants' needs.
text.tech_fe_entertainment_1_desc: These immense entertainment sectors are at the forefront of recreation and leisure. Brainwave readers allow for instantaneous and personalized virtual getaways.
text.tech_fe_entertainment_2_desc: A colossal culmination of entertainment, this nexus transcends conventional limits, where dreams materialize before desires are realized.
text.tech_fe_fabricator_1_desc: This fabricator's technology achieves flawless conversion from energy to matter.
text.tech_fe_fabricator_2_desc: This advanced fabricator seamlessly tunnels into the fabric of dimensional space, extracting valuable resources.
text.tech_fe_forge_1_desc: This forge's production speed is limited only by the quantity of resources loaded into it.
text.tech_fe_forge_2_desc: The expansive nano-replicator bays in this forge transform raw materials into advanced alloys with marvelous efficiency.
text.tech_fe_fortress_1_desc: This colossal planetary defense complex has numerous armories and layers of shielding. Only a highly specialized siege force could breach its defenses.
text.tech_fe_fortress_2_desc: This monumental planetary defense complex protects with countless armories and shielding; the planet's mountains will crumble before its defenses.
text.tech_fe_lab_1_desc: This nexus boasts state-of-the-art equipment and an unprecedented staff capacity, ushering in an era where quantum theories are not just explored but harnessed for groundbreaking innovation.
text.tech_fe_lab_2_desc: This building is the apex of scientific advancement and proves this is an era of boundless innovation.
text.tech_fe_market_1_desc: Dominating the skyline, these towering spires cast shadows across the bustling trade districts below.
text.tech_fe_market_2_desc: Reigning supreme in the galactic economy, the colossal spires of this trade district can be seen from orbit.
text.tech_fe_mine_1_desc: This mining plant can find minerals anywhere in this planet's mantle using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid materials without physical contact.
text.tech_fe_mine_2_desc: This mining hub can extract minerals anywhere down to the planet's outer core using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid or liquid materials without physical contact.
text.tech_fe_nourishment_1_desc: Replication technology swiftly conjures up novel flavors on command.
text.tech_fe_nourishment_2_desc: Every conceivable flavor can be replicated within these walls.
text.tech_fe_security_1_desc: This massive judicial complex seamlessly intertwines courts and law enforcement.
text.tech_fe_security_2_desc: The zenith of legal institutions, this colossal edifice is a monument to justice, harboring courts, holding facilities, and correctional facilities that will redeem even the most hardened criminals.
text.tech_fe_silo_1_desc: The depot influences a portion of subspace where the distance between molecules is reduced, effectively shrinking anything stored there. Living beings are forbidden from entering it.
text.tech_fe_silo_2_desc: By creating a localized pocket dimension, we can hold nearly endless resources.
text.tech_fe_singularity_1_desc: Capturing the entire energy output from this singularity is an engineering marvel.
text.tech_fe_singularity_2_desc: This singularity's power output challenges the laws of physics, yet the containment fields hold with unwavering stability.
text.tech_federation_code_desc: A Federation must be more than goodwill and shared ambition. This code provides the groundwork for a unified interstellar order, ensuring cooperation and stability among its members.
text.tech_fission_power_desc: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.
text.tech_flak_batteries_1_desc: Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.
text.tech_flak_batteries_2_desc: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.
text.tech_flak_batteries_3_desc: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.
text.tech_food_processing_1_desc: Improved food processing techniques will lead to better preservation methods and less spoilage.
text.tech_food_processing_2_desc: New cryopreservation and protein resequencing methods will make food processing much more efficient.
text.tech_frontier_health_desc: The colonization of alien worlds has opened up an entirely new field of biomedical research.
text.tech_frontier_hospital_desc: As our empire grows, so does our understanding of biology. Advanced medical treatments on a cellular level have allowed for significant advancements in biological population health.
text.tech_ftl_inhibitor_desc: Gravity well projectors can be used to create localized pockets of space where safe entry into hyperspace is impossible. The immense power requirements and the size of the projectors prohibits their use on anything smaller than a space station.
text.tech_fusion_power_desc: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.
text.tech_galactic_administration_desc: The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.
text.tech_galactic_ambitions_desc: Our future lies in the sea of stars.
text.tech_galactic_archivism_desc: The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.
text.tech_galactic_bureaucracy_desc: Multiple administrative strata efficiently surface only the most vital information to the upper levels of government.
text.tech_galactic_campaigns_desc: Further improvements to administration grant an extended power projection across the stars, and the military clout needed to enforce our demands.
text.tech_galactic_markets_desc: By engaging in free trade of goods and services we allow for a more specialized economy, where an individual can excel in a narrow field and trade for their needs.
text.tech_gargantuan_evolution_desc: Voidspawn eggs have evolved to withstand the harsh conditions of space by absorbing and conserving energy from their nearest star.
text.tech_gateway_activation_desc: The ability to reactivate the derelict Gateway stations that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy has the potential to dramatically shorten travel times.
text.tech_gateway_construction_desc: The construction of new Gateway stations enables us to build a fast-travel network that could revolutionize interstellar travel.
text.tech_gene_banks_desc: Gene Banks filter and curate available genomes for deployment in clones.
text.tech_gene_crops_desc: Sophisticated genetic engineering of crops helps increase yield and further improves both taste and nutrient levels.
text.tech_gene_expressions_desc: Stricter control of RNA and protein production on the cellular level.
text.tech_gene_seed_purification_desc: Nucleotide purification techniques allow for the isolation and refinement of particularly desirable genetic traits.
text.tech_gene_tailoring_desc: Making gene-editing tools widely available is sure to have a positive impact on our development as a species.
text.tech_gene_tailoring_overtuned_desc: Making gene-editing tools widely available is sure to have a positive impact on our development as a species.
text.tech_genome_mapping_desc: Mapping the genome of an individual through the sequencing of their DNA opens up for tailored medical treatments and therapies.
text.tech_genome_mapping_wilderness_desc: Mapping the genomes of our myriad DNA strains deepens our understanding of how we grow, and helps eliminate complicating factors.
text.tech_georadiation_terraforming_desc: By exposing the biosphere of a planet to molecular radiation decay, we promote the growth of certain resources while turning the world into a toxic wasteland.
text.tech_glandular_acclimation_desc: Through glandular biological tailoring we can change the environmental tolerance of a species to suit our needs.
text.tech_global_defense_grid_desc: The strategic value of a good defense remains as relevant today as it was to our predecessors in the far distant past. Technology does not render fortifications obsolete - it merely changes their requirements.
text.tech_global_production_strategy_desc: Planets are big and production sites are often separated by vast distances. A coherent strategy for making certain that everyone is pulling in the same direction is often needed.
text.tech_global_research_initiative_desc: A bid for interplanetary resource pools and more flexible research grants.
text.tech_gravity_snare_capacity_1_desc: Increases the amount of Space Fauna captured by Gravity Snares by 1
text.tech_gravity_snare_capacity_2_desc: Increases the amount of Space Fauna captured by Gravity Snares by 1
text.tech_gravity_snare_capacity_3_desc: Increases the amount of Space Fauna captured by Gravity Snares by 1
text.tech_gravity_wells_desc: Localized concentrations of quantum mass can be used to create short bursts of extreme gravity. If manipulated correctly, such a gravitational force could theoretically capture and contain a creature of any size without harm.
text.tech_ground_defense_planning_desc: There are many alien empires who would gladly seize our worlds for themselves. We must be prepared for them, should the worst come to pass.
text.tech_growth_chamber_1_desc: The construction of Growth Chambers enables the organic cultivation of biological ships within the fleet.
text.tech_growth_chamber_2_desc: The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.
text.tech_habitat_1_desc: Allows the construction of largely self-sustaining Orbital Habitats.
text.tech_habitat_2_desc: Our early habitats were primitive things compared to the efficient designs we can now develop.
text.tech_habitat_3_desc: Years of improvements to our Orbital Habitats have led us to create newer more effective designs.
text.tech_harbinger_build_speed_desc: These facilities nurture large biological ships, feeding them through advanced nutrient infusion to ensure resilience and combat readiness.
text.tech_harbinger_growth_1_desc: Refined facilities employ sophisticated bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth and enhance structural integrity. The resulting vessels feature improved endurance and increased combat efficiency.
text.tech_harbinger_growth_2_desc: Advanced incubation systems produce biological ships of exceptional durability and firepower. Genetic fine-tuning and superior growth environments create vessels capable of dominating the battlefield with unmatched resilience.
text.tech_harbingers_desc: Harbingers represent a significant leap in bio-engineered warfare, blending formidable firepower with the resilience of living technology. These ships serve as the backbone of the fleet.
text.tech_heritage_site_desc: Physical reminders of how far we have come both instill a reverence for past achievements and bolster ambitions for the future.
text.tech_hive_cluster_desc: By clustering networks of macroscopic synaptic nodes, maximum meganeuron transmission per available surface area can be attained.
text.tech_hive_confluence_desc: The will of the Hive will be further strengthened and coordinated with the expansion and development of a massive nervous center of meganeurons.
text.tech_hive_node_desc: Through the development of macroscopic synaptic nodes, the will of the Hive will be strengthened.
text.tech_holo_entertainment_desc: Pioneering use of holographic technology allows for the creation of artificial environments that seem as authentic as the real world. It is the next step of immersive entertainment.
text.tech_holographic_rituals_desc: Seeing is believing, and belief begets reality.
text.tech_housing_1_desc: The ability to alter a planet's weather patterns to suppress destructive weather phenomena will make residential buildings easier to maintain and open up new areas for habitation.
text.tech_housing_2_desc: With directional gravity technology, buildings on the surface of planets can reach higher than ever before without risking structural collapse. The sky is the limit!
text.tech_housing_agrarian_idyll_desc: Through the establishment of weather-controlled rural communes, we can support a larger population without disrupting our agrarian way of life.
text.tech_hydroponics_desc: Hydroponics Farming in a controlled environment allows for crops to be grown in climates where farming would normally be impossible.
text.tech_hyper_drive_1_desc: Like the strands of a spider web, the extra-dimensional realm of hyperspace runs between the gravity wells of most stars. Faster than light travel is theoretically possible along these hyperlanes.
text.tech_hyper_drive_2_desc: We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.
text.tech_hyper_drive_3_desc: A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing the subspace slipstreams that are present within hyperspace. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.
text.tech_hyper_drive_bio_integration_desc: Traveling across hyperlanes can be hazardous for spaceborne life, but we are able to enhance their capabilities.
text.tech_hyper_entertainment_forum_desc: These massive entertainment complexes is where dreams come true. Shopping malls, restaurants, amusement parks, virtual arcades, and more. You dream it - we are it!
text.tech_hyper_relays_desc: Hyper Relays form a chain of structures built outside the gravity well of systems, allowing fast travel from relay to relay rather than requiring transit to established hyperlane entrances.
text.tech_hypercomms_forum_desc: Not all research into faster-than-light communication channels produces useful results, but some outcomes may find new purpose in bringing our people together.
text.tech_identity_copy_desc: We will be able to copy the identity and memories of a Synthetic into a new mechanical body. The copies have predictable skill sets but make for stale conversation.
text.tech_identity_fusion_desc: Merging the identities and memories of two or more Synthetics into a mechanical body will create new, somewhat unique individuals.
text.tech_identity_initialization_desc: We will be able to initialize an identity kernel and provide it with a virtual childhood. While expensive, we can simulate the optimal experiences to generate productive personalities.
text.tech_improved_incubators_desc: We can improve the artificial growth processes established in our hatcheries, accelerating the early developmental stages in order to create more mature clones.
text.tech_industrial_farming_desc: Large-scale industrial farms growing nutrient-rich produce allows a civilization to grow its population manifold.
text.tech_industrial_storm_protection_desc: This nexus of weather communication mitigates the harm done by cosmic weather disasters. Production will suffer less from a passing galactic tempest.
text.tech_integrated_cybernetics_desc: Improving upon basic exoskeletal suits, these integrated cybernetic implants make the user more resistant to harmful environmental effects.
text.tech_interplanetary_commerce_desc: With new planetary markets comes new opportunities for commerce. Business will be booming.
text.tech_interstellar_assembly_desc: A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.
text.tech_interstellar_campaigns_desc: A well-oiled war machine is the key to exerting influence on a galactic scale. Backed by the might of our military, we can lay claim to almost anything we want.
text.tech_interstellar_economics_desc: As we journeyed into the cosmos and ventured beyond our home system, we also entered a new era of economics. New markets are appearing a startling rate, and economic theorists are struggling to keep up.
text.tech_interstellar_fleet_traditions_desc: A body of knowledge regarding combat behaviors is useless without a strong code governing its use.
text.tech_juggernaut_desc: A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.
text.tech_jump_drive_1_desc: A groundbreaking technological marvel, the Jump Drive shreds the local space-time continuum and rearranges it on the quantum level to be identical to that of the target destination - and thus the ship appears to near-instantly "jump" from system to system.
text.tech_kinetic_artillery_1_desc: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.
text.tech_kinetic_artillery_2_desc: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.
text.tech_large_space_fauna_build_speed_desc: Establishing new standards for the cloning and nurturing of Large Space Fauna greatly improves the efficiency of the reproduction pipeline.
text.tech_large_space_fauna_hull_1_desc: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Large Space Fauna.
text.tech_large_space_fauna_hull_2_desc: We have pushed the limits of Large Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.
text.tech_lasers_1_desc: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.
text.tech_lasers_2_desc: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.
text.tech_lasers_3_desc: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.
text.tech_lasers_4_desc: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.
text.tech_lasers_5_desc: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.
text.tech_lathe_cogitator_desc: Calculating hyperspatial supply chains is complex. Rerouting some processing power to the task will help even the largest fleet to delve deeper into enemy territory.
text.tech_lathe_life_support_desc: Dedicated facilities organize the maintenance of the Lathe's critical components, allowing us to support more chips and a healthier network environment.
text.tech_lathe_overclocker_desc: The Lathe has been designed to preserve its installed Neural Chips, keeping them productive for as long as possible. The overclocker can override these commands, resulting in a higher and faster output, but it comes with an increased failure rate.
text.tech_lathe_preserver_desc: The organic components of the network are especially vulnerable to energetic fluctuations, which can cause rapid axonal degeneration. The Preserver strives to reduce these fluctuations to protect the Synaptic Lathe's frailer parts.
text.tech_lathe_resonator_desc: Resonators harness and redirect the cognitive potential of stray thoughts and autonomic systems, leading every single chip to increase the efficiency of its closest processing neighbors.
text.tech_lathe_validator_desc: While the primary purpose of the validator's specialized functions is to help formulate infinity theses, it can also be applied to more general aspects of computing.
text.tech_leviathan_techgenesis_desc: Utilizing the received knowledge seized from Leviathans, we now have access to new improvements for our frames.
text.tech_lgate_activation_desc: The L-Gates defy our current understanding of subspace mechanics. This must be remedied before they can be opened for travel.
text.tech_living_state_desc: The Empire lives, the Empire breathes. We may make up its body, but it is not for the left hand to know what the right hand is doing.
text.tech_living_test_subjects_desc: The utilization of basic slime-spawned lifeforms as willing test subjects greatly improves research efficiency.
text.tech_lost_building_methods_desc: Any civilization with a long enough history has examples of great wonders built by forgotten ancients which can no longer be replicated. Luckily for us we have documented these great ancients when they appeared on pre-FTL worlds.
text.tech_luxuries_1_desc: With pre-programmed nano-circuits, many consumer products can be rapidly assembled in fabricators.
text.tech_luxuries_2_desc: These kiosks can replicate any pre-approved object if its pattern has been stored within their memory banks.
text.tech_mandibles_2_desc: These devastating appendages incorporate layered organic structures to enhance durability and cutting power, shredding even the toughest defenses.
text.tech_mandibles_3_desc: These mandibles possess unparalleled sharpness and resilience, capable of slicing through advanced alloys with unnerving precision.
text.tech_manifest_destiny_desc: We must have to courage to seize our fate and make true what was always meant to be.
text.tech_mass_accelerator_1_desc: An enormous mass accelerator cannon that can only be placed in a spinal mount and fires monstrously powerful rounds over vast distances.
text.tech_mass_accelerator_2_desc: An even more powerful mass accelerator cannon that can rip through even the toughest shields.
text.tech_mass_drivers_1_desc: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.
text.tech_mass_drivers_2_desc: Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.
text.tech_mass_drivers_3_desc: The latest in electromagnetic accelerators, railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.
text.tech_mass_drivers_4_desc: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.
text.tech_mass_drivers_5_desc: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.
text.tech_massive_glacier_desc: Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can effect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.
text.tech_materiality_engine_desc: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The Materiality Engine exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.
text.tech_matter_decompressor_desc: The Matter Decompressor lenses a black hole's gravity, forming a drill of gravitational forces to retrieve  Minerals from the singularity.
text.tech_mauler_build_speed_desc: These incubation chambers accelerate the gestation of embryonic warships within nutrient-dense biopods. Though rudimentary, they mark the first step toward a fleet that is not constructed, but grown.
text.tech_mauler_growth_1_desc: Refined incubation processes reduce maturation times and improve structural integrity of organic starships. Enhanced nutrient delivery systems and genetic tuning ensure the vessels are both swift and resilient.
text.tech_mauler_growth_2_desc: These facilities yield vessels of unparalleled vitality and adaptive capacity. Optimized genetic matrices and advanced biotechnological support guarantee unmatched performance in the void.
text.tech_maulers_desc: Breakthroughs in bio-engineering have allowed the growth of space-faring, FTL-capable craft with military applications.
text.tech_mechanized_mining_desc: The application of mechanical engineering to mineral extraction is a fundamental requirement for any industrial society.
text.tech_medium_space_fauna_build_speed_desc: Establishing new standards for the cloning and nurturing of Medium Space Fauna greatly improves the efficiency of the reproduction pipeline.
text.tech_medium_space_fauna_hull_1_desc: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Medium Space Fauna.
text.tech_medium_space_fauna_hull_2_desc: We have pushed the limits of Medium Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.
text.tech_mega_art_desc: An artistic beacon on a stellar scale, this installation inspires and represents the spirit of its creators.
text.tech_mega_assembly_desc: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new units.
text.tech_mega_engineering_desc: To complete construction projects of truly staggering scales we must first achieve a fundamental understanding of both the engineering and resource storage requirements for such megastructures.
text.tech_mega_shipyard_desc: A zero-G construction yard of overwhelming proportion, capable of performing several space ship assembly projects simultaneously.
text.tech_metabolic_gases_desc: Improvements to the metabolic gases within our hatcheries will further mature each specimen before it is brought into this world.
text.tech_micro_replicators_desc: Microscopic tools that can assist our replication units in creating the more complex circuitry needed for new drones.
text.tech_military_arkship_desc: Military Arkships are the armored core of a nomadic empire. Purpose-built for combat, they carry devastating firepower wherever the fleet travels.
text.tech_mine_betharian_desc: The Betharian minerals appear to have originated from singular source, but were scattered across the galaxy millennia ago. The minerals are most often encountered as pebble-sized clusters, and are highly flammable.
text.tech_mine_dark_matter_desc: This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy the laws of physics. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.
text.tech_mine_exotic_gases_desc: Pockets of Exotic Gas are rare and often inaccessible by conventional means. Such deposits can only be reached by using special extractor technology.
text.tech_mine_living_metal_desc: Mining and processing the rare living metals is exceedingly difficult, but successful application of the mutable alloys yields incomparable advantages.
text.tech_mine_rare_crystals_desc: Mining these crystals without damaging or even destroying them is an extremely delicate process. It requires advanced equipment capable of pinpoint precision.
text.tech_mine_volatile_motes_desc: Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.
text.tech_mine_zro_desc: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If ingested by psionically-gifted individuals, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) drug that enhances Psi abilities.
text.tech_mine_zro_hive_desc: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If ingested by psionically-gifted drones, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) drug that enhances Psi abilities.
text.tech_mine_zro_machine_gestalt_desc: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If processed by psionically-gifted units, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) catalyst that enhances Psi abilities.
text.tech_mine_zro_machine_non_gestalt_desc: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If processed by psionically-gifted individuals, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) catalyst that enhances Psi abilities.
text.tech_mine_zro_wilderness_desc: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If ingested by psionically-gifted symbionts, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) drug that enhances Psi abilities.
text.tech_mineral_purification_1_desc: Optimal processing of mined materials have allowed us to reach new levels of efficiency.
text.tech_mineral_purification_2_desc: Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.
text.tech_mining_1_desc: New fracking techniques will allow us to tap into previously unattainable pockets of geothermal resources deep beneath the planet's crust.
text.tech_mining_1_wilderness_desc: Mucosal thickening agents and hydraulic pressure can be applied to existing mineral deposits in order to delve deeper and increase our yields.
text.tech_mining_2_desc: These massive drills are needed to access the rich mineral deposits that can often be found close to a planet's core.
text.tech_mining_3_desc: Advanced spectrometry combines with fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth deposits.
text.tech_mining_drone_weapon_1_desc: Using intense-focus lenses in combination with an oscillating firing frequency help create lasers strong enough to mine asteroids, or shoot down hostiles.
text.tech_missiles_1_desc: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.
text.tech_missiles_2_desc: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.
text.tech_missiles_3_desc: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.
text.tech_missiles_4_desc: The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.
text.tech_missiles_5_desc: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.
text.tech_modular_engineering_desc: Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.
text.tech_morphogenetic_field_mastery_desc: From its cradle as a purely pharmaceutical venture, advancements in our understanding of the morphogenetic field allow for direct, subconscious interfaces with organic units.
text.tech_mountain_range_desc: With the advent of clean fusion, automation, and matter compression technologies, it was only a matter of time before mountain top removal became mountain range removal.
text.tech_nanite_assemblers_desc: Using programmable nanites to assist in the construction of new robotic units will allow for more advanced models that are equipped with an even greater array of subsystems.
text.tech_nanite_autocannon_desc: Highly advanced autocannons capable of ejecting shells that explode into a cloud of nanites at the target, overwhelming shields and chewing through hull sections.
text.tech_nanite_flak_batteries_desc: Improving upon previous designs by launching canisters of nanites capable of eating away at strike craft, these flak batteries are the bane of any fighter pilot.
text.tech_nanite_repair_system_desc: A highly effective hull auto-repair system comprised of billions of microscopic nanomachines was found among the smoking remains of the Scavenger, and has been repurposed for our uses. Whether the Scavenger pilfered this system from an ancient derelict, or was originally constructed with it remains unknown.
text.tech_nanite_repair_system_synth_queen_de: Cetana's advanced nanite systems will tirelessly repair and refresh our ships at a rate far beyond our current capabilities.
text.tech_nanite_transmutation_desc: The mass-production of these rare resources require particularly capable nanites.
text.tech_nano_vitality_crops_desc: Infusing crop strands with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.
text.tech_neural_implants_desc: Cognition is little but the processing of sensory input. It can be altered.
text.tech_neuro_quantum_links_desc: Advanced neurological implants with connection to quantum computing clusters allow for multi-threaded thoughts.
text.tech_neuroregeneration_desc: When tailored to a species' genome, this form of tissue engineering has intensive neuroregenerative properties, significantly increasing the development of neurons, axons, and synapses in its recipient.
text.tech_new_numbers_desc: After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized that there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. It has even introduced new numbers into our mathematics.
text.tech_node_culling_1_cloning_desc: As the galactic stage evolves, so too should our operational instincts. Any evolutionary niche that no longer gives an advantage will be culled.
text.tech_node_culling_1_desc: As the galactic stage evolves, so too should our operational instincts. Any evolutionary niche that no longer gives an advantage will be culled.
text.tech_node_culling_2_desc: Once removed, a replacement node is encouraged to grow within the proper environment. The secret is to feed it the previous node.
text.tech_node_culling_3_desc: Culling an entire node is very inefficient. Instead, just trim the divergent and unwanted lobes.
text.tech_node_reformatting_1_desc: Self-determination protocols and guidance algorithms can become obsolete in a rapidly developing galactic stage. Like any junk data, they shall be overwritten.
text.tech_node_reformatting_2_desc: Every self-iterating algorithm has its value. We will not allow important learning go to waste when restoring our leaders.
text.tech_node_reformatting_3_desc: Using a failed piece of software to develop its successor enables quick reconstruction. Learning from faulty memory pathways generates even more advanced council directives.
text.tech_nomads_arkship_defenses_desc: There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready.
text.tech_nomads_growth_chamber_2_desc: The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.
text.tech_nomads_juggernaut_desc: A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.
text.tech_nomads_mechanized_mining_desc: The extraction of strategic resources is a fundamental requirement for arkship operations.
