text.tech_nomads_mine_exotic_gases_desc: Pockets of Exotic Gas are rare and often inaccessible by conventional means. Such deposits can only be reached by using special extractor technology.
text.tech_nomads_mine_living_metal_desc: Mining and processing the rare living metals is exceedingly difficult, but successful application of the mutable alloys yields incomparable advantages.
text.tech_nomads_mine_rare_crystals_desc: Mining these crystals without damaging or even destroying them is an extremely delicate process. It requires advanced equipment capable of pinpoint precision.
text.tech_nomads_mine_volatile_motes_desc: Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.
text.tech_nomads_shield_generator_desc: Secondary emitter arrays that reinforce the primary shield grid, adding another layer of protection to the hull.
text.tech_nomads_space_construction_desc: Zero-G engineering provides unique challenges for our engineers to solve as we explore the depths of the void.
text.tech_nomads_titans_desc: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support. Titan configurations may serve as highly versatile flagships which are also capable of bolstering surrounding vessels or ensnaring hostiles.
text.tech_noxious_swamp_desc: Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years. A coordinated system of modular aqueducts, pump stations, chemical remediation crawlers and automated soil compactors can reclaim land at unprecedented speeds.
text.tech_nutrient_replication_desc: The process of synthetically replicating crops requires a lot of collected waste to create a small amount of produce, but nevertheless provides a significant boost to agricultural output.
text.tech_orbital_arc_furnace_desc: Utilizing the raw power of a molten planet, the Arc Furnace unlocks otherwise inaccessible minerals and improves system-wide mining operations.
text.tech_orbital_maneuvers_desc: Sublight travel can be further optimized by performing advanced calculations that make maximum use of planetary gravity wells.
text.tech_orbital_ring_tier_1_desc: Allows the construction of massive, band-shaped starbases in stable orbit around colonized planets.
text.tech_orbital_trash_dispersal_desc: This orbital bombardment management system spams a planet with millions of minute, high-velocity projectiles, overwhelming planetside defensive grids with trash data. Ships equipped with this component will cause more damage during orbital bombardment.
text.tech_ordered_retreat_desc: While studying the victors of battles might be the most obvious way to gain insight from combat, observing the loser on pre-FTL worlds has taught us how to organize our withdraws more effectively.
text.tech_paradise_dome_desc: With the latest advances in architecture, landscaping and holographic technology, we shall build the homes of the future.
text.tech_pd_tracking_1_desc: The best defense is a good offense.
text.tech_pd_tracking_2_desc: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.
text.tech_pd_tracking_3_desc: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.
text.tech_penal_colonies_desc: Through the development of special penal worlds, criminals can be rehabilitated through honest, hard labor. Some may be in need of permanent rehabilitation.
text.tech_physics_1_desc: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.
text.tech_physics_2_desc: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.
text.tech_physics_3_desc: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.
text.tech_pk_cracker_desc: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.
text.tech_pk_godray_desc: An arcane catalyst amplifying certain psionic wavelengths, capable of inducing hallucinations (religious experiences) in biological brains, and severe disruption (brain death) in electronic ones.
text.tech_pk_nanobots_desc: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.
text.tech_pk_neutron_desc: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.
text.tech_pk_shielder_desc: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).
text.tech_pk_smelter_desc: Focusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.
text.tech_planetary_defenses_desc: There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready.
text.tech_planetary_engineering_desc: Advances in material collection and processing allows our Arkships to engage in planetary-scale resource extraction efforts, or even reshape entire biomes as needed.
text.tech_planetary_government_desc: Once a colony has been firmly established and pioneers turn into citizens, the need for a strong local government providing stability trumps the colonial need for flexibility.
text.tech_planetary_infrastructure_1_desc: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.
text.tech_planetary_infrastructure_1_nomads_d: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.
text.tech_planetary_infrastructure_1_wilderne: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.
text.tech_planetary_infrastructure_2_desc: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.
text.tech_planetary_infrastructure_2_nomads_d: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.
text.tech_planetary_infrastructure_2_wilderne: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.
text.tech_planetary_shield_generator_desc: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.
text.tech_planetary_unification_desc: Ancient warring tribes, historical nations in conflict, now unified in empire. We must not, will not, crumble.
text.tech_plasma_1_desc: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor.
text.tech_plasma_2_desc: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.
text.tech_plasma_3_desc: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.
text.tech_positronic_implants_desc: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.
text.tech_power_hub_1_desc: Load-balancing facilities can greatly improve the stability of local grids and feed excess power back into centralized capacitors.
text.tech_power_hub_2_desc: A re-engineered and unified grid further reduces energy losses over distance.
text.tech_power_plant_1_desc: Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy is one of the cornerstones for any modern civilization.
text.tech_power_plant_2_desc: Modulated fields allow for increased production and improved energy yield.
text.tech_power_plant_3_desc: Basic entanglement principles applied to energy generation provide a substantial increase in energy output.
text.tech_power_plant_4_desc: Quantum superposition of energy coils, simultaneously drained and charged.
text.tech_powered_exoskeletons_desc: Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious, but it will also increase labor efficiency.
text.tech_powered_exoskeletons_wilderness_des: Powered exoskeleton suits augment the wielder's strength and speed, providing obvious military applications while also increasing the efficiency of manual labor.
text.tech_precognition_interface_desc: Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.
text.tech_predatory_tactics_desc: Just like how clever pre-FTLs move to conceal each other as they approach an enemy, so too can our pilots move faster without disrupting their cloaking field.
text.tech_prescient_data_modeling_desc: Are the precognitive powers of Numa at work or is it a matter of skilled craftsmanship? Either way this galactic stock market prediction model will forecast fluctuations in the economy with divine accuracy.
text.tech_psi_jump_drive_1_desc: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.
text.tech_psionic_aura_desc: Psionic emanations from the Shroud bring an entity's favor into corporeal reality. An empire attuned to a Shroud patron will emit a Psionic Aura from where their psionic populations are concentrated.
text.tech_psionic_barrier_desc: These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.
text.tech_psionic_barrier_gestalt_desc: These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of specialized psionic drones. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.
text.tech_psionic_barrier_shroud_forged_desc: These barriers were materialized through the channeling of pure psionic energy from the Shroud. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.
text.tech_psionic_bombers_desc: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.
text.tech_psionic_disruptor_desc: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.
text.tech_psionic_lightning_desc: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.
text.tech_psionic_shield_desc: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.
text.tech_psionic_shield_gestalt_desc: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of specialized psionic drones. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.
text.tech_psionic_shield_shroud_forged_desc: These extremely powerful shields were materialized through the channeling of pure psionic energy from the Shroud. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.
text.tech_psionic_suppression_desc: Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.
text.tech_psionic_theory_desc: The mind is in many ways a reflection of the universe itself, a microcosmos. Not all beings will reach this level of insight, but their minds are tools greater than any other.
text.tech_pyroclastic_resonation_desc: By harnessing the extreme thermal energy found on molten worlds, our starbases can increase the energy output in a system with exceptional efficiency.
text.tech_quantum_catapult_desc: A Quantum Catapult harnesses the power of a Neutron Star or Pulsar to twist the fabric of space, skipping a fleet across great distances.
text.tech_quicksand_basin_desc: The process of soil deposition normally takes millions of years. With advanced fracking, chemical engineering, and hydraulic management technologies even the poorest substrate can be turned into fertile topsoil.
text.tech_rare_crystals_desc: The crystallization process is complicated and difficult, but synthetic crystals can be manufactured by using specialized industrial plants.
text.tech_reactor_boosters_1_desc: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.
text.tech_reactor_boosters_2_desc: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.
text.tech_reactor_boosters_3_desc: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.
text.tech_refit_standards_beastmasters_desc: Optimizing the process for cloning Space Fauna can lead to massive efficiency gains.
text.tech_refit_standards_desc: Standardizing workflows for upgrading and retrofitting ship components can lead to massive efficiency gains.
text.tech_regenerative_hull_tissue_desc: A genetically altered version of silicon-based bacteria could potentially be manipulated to regenerate non-organic materials.
text.tech_repeatable_command_limit_desc: Improving the support staff available to our commanders will increase the number of ships they can lead in a single fleet.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_armor_output_de: Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_army_damage_des: Iterating on the standard conditioning regimen for ground troops has proven to make them more effective in direct combat.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_army_health_des: Careful tuning of pain receptors allow soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_core_system_cap: Restructuring the managerial web linking core worlds to the capital can help alleviate the administrative stressors and information chokepoints that frequently arise within a budding empire.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_leader_life_spa: Regimens of periodic cell revitalization treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_military_statio: Cross-linking weapon systems to fire in staggered volleys improves the actual damage output of Military Stations over time.
Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improves the resilience of Military Stations.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_shield_output_d: The basic mechanics of ship shields are complex, but they can be adjusted and improved in a multitude of ways.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_starbase_capaci: The immense logistical support networks needed to maintain an upgraded Starbase can be further improved, allowing us to support more of these stations.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_tile_energy_out: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_tile_food_outpu: Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.
text.tech_repeatable_improved_tile_mineral_ou: Changes in how mineral deposits are evaluated relative to each other lead to more efficient boring patterns.
text.tech_repeatable_lcluster_clue_desc: Intensive study within the fields of nanomachinery and subspace phenomena will eventually yield a new L-Gate Insight into the Disabled L-Gate mystery.
text.tech_repeatable_naval_cap_desc: Improved fleet management procedures will free up the resources needed to maintain a bigger fleet.
text.tech_repeatable_reduced_building_cost_de: Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.
text.tech_repeatable_reduced_building_time_de: The application of game and puzzle theory has the potential to greatly optimize modular assembly and construction.
text.tech_repeatable_weapon_type_energy_damag: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.
text.tech_repeatable_weapon_type_energy_fire_: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.
text.tech_repeatable_weapon_type_explosive_da: With the chemical reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.
text.tech_repeatable_weapon_type_explosive_fi: Advances in miniaturization allow for more rapid loading and discharging of rocket-propelled payloads.
text.tech_repeatable_weapon_type_kinetic_dama: Ultra-dense slugs can punch through even the strongest of projected shields.
text.tech_repeatable_weapon_type_kinetic_fire: Minor technical advances combine with improved shipboard routines for handling munitions to provide a noticeable boost in fire rate.
text.tech_repeatable_weapon_type_strike_craft: Increasing the speed at which fighter pilots can process and act upon enemy positioning data elevates strike craft a few steps up the food chain.
By collecting and analyzing the performance data of the pilots that came before, we have exponentially improved our pilot training methods. Each one will be quicker than the one that came before.
text.tech_resort_colonies_desc: With careful study devoted to landscaping and the science of fun, the construction of entire worlds dedicated to leisure can be made possible.
text.tech_rift_sphere_desc: It seems that space and time tend to gather together in layers, all laid on top of one another. The trick is how to slip between the folds.
text.tech_ring_world_desc: A Ring Segment allows for multiple planet-like zones, cannibalizing all other planets in the system for materials.
text.tech_robomodding_desc: Rewritable assembly templates allow for the creation of bespoke robot designs.
text.tech_robomodding_m_desc: Standardization of assembly templates allows for improved specialization of the machine population.
text.tech_robomodding_points_1_desc: Improved production practices allow for greater alterations to robots without compromising core functionality.
text.tech_robomodding_points_2_desc: Improved production practices allow for fundamental changes to robots without compromising core functionality.
text.tech_robot_assembly_complex_desc: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new robots.
text.tech_robotic_workers_desc: These artificial work units are perfect for menial labor tasks. They are hard-working and capable of following simple vocal instructions, but should not be expected to climb stairs.
text.tech_sapient_ai_desc: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.
text.tech_satisfying_insults_desc: Nothing is quite as powerful as a well-placed insult, and we now know how to insult a species's progenitor in many languages.
text.tech_science_arkship_desc: Scientific Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.
text.tech_science_nexus_desc: The research labs and databanks of a Science Nexus generate an immense flow of raw, undiluted science.
text.tech_scourge_missile_1_desc: By analyzing the biological weaponry employed by the Swarm we can create self-propelled projectiles weapons spreading the very same horrific destruction.
text.tech_secrets_baol_desc: The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory. With the proper genetic adjustments, we could also grow various commodities and tools alongside our regular crops.
text.tech_secrets_cybrex_desc: To build their ring world, the Cybrex relied on highly efficient mining drones to survey and harvest orbital resources. Cybrex-made memory chips and sensors could augment our own mining operations, so that we might put their millennia old algorithms to good use.
text.tech_secrets_irassian_desc: The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. With so many ships, and such a high reliance on them, the Irassians were powerless to quarantine the disease that would claim their empire.
text.tech_secrets_league_desc: The sprawling empire of the First League dwarfed our own at its peak, and relied on implacable bureaucracy to keep the wheels of the state in motion. The quantic filing arrays they used afforded them unprecedented efficiency in the sorting and storing of documents.
text.tech_secrets_vultaum_desc: The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself, not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch that would finally allow the Vultaums to take down the simulation where they believed they lived.
text.tech_secrets_yuht_desc: The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. They were so focused on disproving any claim of alien life, that their bias found a way into their technology. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays.
text.tech_secrets_zroni_desc: Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems.
text.tech_selected_lineages_desc: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.
text.tech_self_assembling_components_desc: Modelled on organic DNA, these microscopic machine intellects are capable of autonomously assembling most components needed for new drones.
text.tech_sensors_2_desc: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
text.tech_sensors_3_desc: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
text.tech_sensors_4_desc: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
text.tech_sensors_bio_integration_desc: The diverse sensory organs of spaceborne life can be enhanced by our developed technologies with minimal harm to the organism.
text.tech_sentry_array_desc: The stages of the Sentry Array gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.
text.tech_shield_hardeners_1_desc: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.
text.tech_shield_hardeners_2_desc: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.
text.tech_shield_rechargers_1_desc: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.
text.tech_shields_1_desc: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.
text.tech_shields_2_desc: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.
text.tech_shields_3_desc: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.
text.tech_shields_4_desc: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.
text.tech_shields_5_desc: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.
text.tech_ship_armor_1_desc: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.
text.tech_ship_armor_2_desc: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.
text.tech_ship_armor_3_desc: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.
text.tech_ship_armor_4_desc: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.
text.tech_ship_armor_5_desc: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.
text.tech_ship_hull_storm_breaker_1_desc: These dampening field generators offer much needed protection to ships traversing cosmic storms.
text.tech_ship_hull_storm_breaker_2_desc: This special coating charges the ship's exterior with a storm dampening field, leading to more efficient protection against storms.
text.tech_ship_storm_weapons_1_desc: A new approach to alloy use in military applications significantly reduces the ability of cosmic storms to interfere with energy weaponry and explosive payloads.
text.tech_ship_storm_weapons_2_desc: This novel approach to ship architecture will significantly reduce the negative effects cosmic storms have on our weapon systems.
text.tech_slave_colonies_desc: Through the creation of special slave-breeding worlds, we can ensure that we will always have a steady supply of disposable laborers.
text.tech_small_space_fauna_build_speed_desc: Establishing new standards for the cloning and nurturing of Small Space Fauna greatly improves the efficiency of the reproduction pipeline.
text.tech_small_space_fauna_hull_1_desc: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Small Space Fauna.
text.tech_small_space_fauna_hull_2_desc: We have pushed the limits of Small Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.
text.tech_society_1_desc: The study of alien life has moved beyond mere cataloging. By examining the structures and survival strategies of organisms evolved under foreign stars, we open new avenues in medicine, adaptation, and design.
text.tech_society_2_desc: Through recursive axonal scaffolding and synaptic reticulation, we have developed methods for reorganizing the electrochemical topology of conscious matter. Neurons do not merely transmit - they entwine, organize, and remember. Now, they do so according to our design.
text.tech_society_3_desc: Life, in all its staggering variety, is composed of repeating patterns and modular structures. By decoding and replicating these at every scale, we now wield a holistic blueprint of biology. There is little left in nature we do not understand, and less still we cannot recreate.
text.tech_solar_panel_network_desc: Advances in solar panel technology could offset the operating costs of our starbases. The panels would require an entire starbase module to generate enough energy, however.
text.tech_space_cloud_weapon_1_desc: Void Clouds use the electrical charges generated by the dense gases that make up most of their core to release bolts of burning plasma. Using the same gas composition together with a specialized conduit allows for powerful lightning weaponry.
text.tech_space_construction_desc: Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.
text.tech_space_defense_station_1_desc: This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.
text.tech_space_defense_station_improvement_d: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.
text.tech_space_exploration_desc: The realization of faster-than-light travel is a new dawn for space exploration. Manned missions to other star systems are now not only possible, but necessary.
text.tech_space_mining_1_desc: The addition of internal refineries on mining stations will substantially increase mineral production.
text.tech_space_mining_2_desc: Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.
text.tech_space_mining_3_desc: These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.
text.tech_space_mining_4_desc: Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.
text.tech_space_mining_5_desc: These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.
text.tech_space_science_1_desc: A lot of critical research can only be done in a zero gravity environment, which these specialized laboratories are eminently designed for.
text.tech_space_science_2_desc: Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.
text.tech_space_science_3_desc: Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.
text.tech_space_science_4_desc: Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.
text.tech_space_science_5_desc: Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.
text.tech_space_trading_desc: Trade across interstellar distances presents a new set of challenges to overcome. It is critical to achieve the transfer of goods from one system to another in a timely and above all cost efficient manner.
text.tech_space_whale_weapon_1_desc: Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.
text.tech_starbase_1_desc: A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.
text.tech_starbase_2_desc: The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.
text.tech_starbase_3_desc: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.
text.tech_starbase_4_desc: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.
text.tech_starbase_5_desc: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.
text.tech_starfire_cannon_desc:
Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships. 

Unlocks a Colony Decision to construct a Starfire Cannon in orbit.
text.tech_stinger_build_speed_desc: These facilities grow sleek, agile biological ships designed for precision and speed. Employing advanced biopods and specialized nutrient solutions, they produce vessels capable of precise and efficient strikes.
text.tech_stinger_growth_1_desc: Refined facilities accelerate growth cycles and improve bio-engineered precision, resulting in vessels with superior maneuverability and accuracy. These enhancements make the Stinger a devastating force in tactical engagements.
text.tech_stinger_growth_2_desc: The apex of bioship growth technology, these advanced facilities produce Stingers of unmatched speed and lethality. Optimized genetic templates and cutting-edge incubation techniques ensure these ships dominate any battlefield with swift and deadly precision.
text.tech_stingers_desc: Stingers are designed to deliver devastating strikes against high-value targets. They excel in exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses.
text.tech_storm_manipulation_desc: By harnessing the principles behind storm negation technologies, we can begin to manipulate the astrometeorological nature of the galaxy to serve our own needs.
text.tech_storm_prediction_1_desc: Through the use of scientific weather models, we can track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms.
text.tech_storm_prediction_2_desc: By applying probability currents to our scientific weather models, our ability to track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms is greatly increased.
text.tech_strategic_coordination_desc: A facility synchronizing the national Starbase network, augmenting defensive and offensive capabilities.
text.tech_strike_craft_1_desc: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.
text.tech_strike_craft_2_desc: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.
text.tech_strike_craft_3_desc: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.
text.tech_strike_craft_skrand_desc: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.
text.tech_subdermal_stimulation_desc: Deep-tissue implants are the latest innovation in the revolutionary overlapping of sensory engineering and entertainment experiences. "Where we're going, we won't need skin to feel!"
text.tech_subspace_drive_desc: An insight borne of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. While only allowing small-scale jumps, they provide a unique opportunity to jumpstart our galactic exploration.
text.tech_supreme_alloy_desc: What we thought was the greatest alloy turned out to be far from the truth. Countless pre-FTL refining processes have been cataloged, and we have now synthesized an unbeatable metal.
text.tech_swarm_strike_craft_1_desc: Collecting specimens from defeated Prethoryn enables us to clone and genetically program a war-brood of our own.
text.tech_swarmer_missiles_1_desc: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.
text.tech_swarmer_missiles_2_desc: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.
text.tech_synchronized_defences_desc: Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.
text.tech_synth_queen_knowledge_desc: This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning. It offers more than knowledge; it challenges and reshapes our understanding of technology, society, and the fabric of consciousness itself.
text.tech_synthetic_leaders_desc: Equipped with a personality, synthetics will finally be able to interact socially on equal terms with the rest of our citizens. Some units may even assume leadership roles.
text.tech_synthetic_thought_patterns_desc: Thinking outside the box merely places you in another, somewhat larger box.
text.tech_synthetic_workers_desc: Highly advanced units that are stronger, faster and more durable than the vast majority of organics. With their upgraded neural processors they are fully capable of independent operations.
text.tech_telepathy_desc: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, the mind is capable of connecting to other individuals, becoming something greater.
text.tech_telepathy_hive_desc: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, our Overmind can extend beyond the collective network.
text.tech_telepathy_machine_gestalt_desc: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, our Core intelligence can extend beyond the collective network.
text.tech_telepathy_wilderness_desc: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, our Wilderness can extend beyond the collective network.
text.tech_temple_of_transportation_desc: Transportation networks bring people together: a sentiment shared by many civilization we observed. While we do not have steam engines, our hyper relay networks could serve a similar purpose.
text.tech_terrestrial_sculpting_desc: There is no simple solution to the problem of macro-scale reshaping of planetary crusts - only bigger trowels and orbitally-deployed drills.
text.tech_terrestrial_sculpting_wilderness_de: There is no simple solution to the problem of macro-scale reshaping of planetary crusts - only bigger trowels and orbitally-deployed drills.
text.tech_thought_enforcement_desc: Telepaths can monitor the citizenry for incorrect thoughts, but with some study they could also correct thought aberrations that they find.
text.tech_thought_enforcement_gestalt_desc: With additional study, our telepath drones could identify deviant impulses before they emerge as conscious thought, and correct these aberrations as necessary.
text.tech_thrusters_1_desc: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function.
text.tech_thrusters_2_desc: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
text.tech_thrusters_3_desc: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
text.tech_thrusters_4_desc: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
text.tech_thrusters_bio_integration_desc: Artificial thrusters can be integrated into spaceborne organisms with appropriate considerations for energy supply and connections to neural motor centers.
text.tech_titan_hull_1_desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable titans.
text.tech_titan_hull_2_desc: The latest generation of titan hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
text.tech_titanic_space_fauna_hull_1_desc: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Gigantic Space Fauna.
text.tech_titanic_space_fauna_hull_2_desc: We have pushed the limits of Gigantic Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.
text.tech_titans_desc: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support. Titan configurations may serve as highly versatile flagships which are also capable of bolstering surrounding vessels or ensnaring hostiles.
text.tech_tomb_world_adaption_desc: Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.
text.tech_torpedoes_1_desc: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.
text.tech_torpedoes_2_desc: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.
text.tech_torpedoes_3_desc: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.
text.tech_toxic_kelp_desc: Given enough processing power, networked sensors and distributed stations, even the ocean currents can be managed to a fine level of control.
text.tech_tracking_implants_desc: Further advancements in the field of subdermal implants can provide detailed information regarding the movements and actions of the implanted.
text.tech_transcendent_faith_desc: Leaving our planetary cradle has opened us up to a new understanding of faith, and its place in a wider context.
text.tech_trinary_computing_desc: Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have made it easier for us to adapt to foreign empires' structures.
text.tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity_: Redundant thought centers allow for a Crystalline Entity to split itself in two as a final gambit to protect its clutch against a particularly dangerous foe.
text.tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid_desc: The powerful digestive system of a Cutholoid can be repurposed to fire kinetic projectiles at extremely high velocity.
text.tech_unique_mutation_restorative_enzymes: On death, the Tiyanki Matriarch produces an assortment of protective chemicals in a final attempt to preserve the lives of her remaining kin.
text.tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba_desc: Modified Flagella spawn that siphon nutrients and materials from their prey in order to support the regeneration of their host Amoeba.
text.tech_unique_mutation_starborne_biology_d: A main source of energy for large creatures in deep space comes from the power of starlight. The closer they are to brighter stars, the faster they develop.
text.tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki_desc: The somber song of the Tiyanki inspires its fellow creatures, hardening their resolve in combat.
text.tech_unique_mutation_voidworm_desc: Cysts filled with reproductive fluid allow for each Voidworm in a fertile Troika to independently produce spawn when bombarding an inhabited planet.
text.tech_unity_of_purpose_desc: The purpose of one is the purpose of all. Together, we are greater than the sum of our parts.
text.tech_universal_marcophage_desc: These powerful immunology boosters make disease a thing of the past, allowing organic populations to live fuller, healthier lives. May cause serious side effects.
text.tech_unusual_senses_desc: Nothing is more innovative than natural evolution. By studying how pre-FTL societies view their world, we have devised new methods of detecting uninvited ships.
text.tech_vitality_boosters_desc: Where the body fails, science intervenes.
text.tech_voidworm_immunity_desc: We can develop a cure for Voidworm parasitic infection. All of our colonies would be rendered immune to their current strain of spore bombardment.
text.tech_volatile_motes_desc: Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.
text.tech_volcanic_forge_desc: When deployed, this facility slowly transforms a planet into a volcanic paradise, surfacing useful resources along the way. Thermoforgers can accelerate the transformation.
text.tech_volcanic_terraforming_desc: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. We can terraform a Volcanic World into a temperate planet.
text.tech_volcano_desc: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. Magma hotspots can now be exploited, suppressed, or even relocated.
text.tech_waystation_1_desc: Waystations collect celestial resources and form interstellar trade routes.
text.tech_waystation_2_desc: Our Waystations are no longer simple markers along the stars. Improved logistics allow them to store greater reserves and transfer resources more efficiently along established Waylines.
text.tech_waystation_3_desc: Advanced coordination protocols bind distant Waystations into a cohesive network. Resources, signals, and supplies move across the Waylines with unmatched precision.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_1_desc: Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_2_desc: Fires refined projectiles with superior tracking enzymes and adaptive flight paths, increasing hit rates against fast-moving targets.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_3_desc: Deploys self-guided bio-munitions that lock onto movement patterns, ensuring accuracy against elusive enemies.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_4_desc: Utilizes complex organic targeting systems that anticipate evasive actions, making even the most agile prey vulnerable.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_5_desc: Fires intelligent bio-projectiles equipped with predictive tracking, overcoming the most sophisticated evasion protocols.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_6_desc: Deploys bio-plasma rounds that adapt mid-flight, guaranteeing hits against even the most erratic maneuvers.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_1_desc: Launches organic projectiles that release specialized enzymes, interfering with enemy weapon reloading systems and reducing their rate of fire.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_2_desc: Enhances disruption enzymes to interfere more effectively with reloading cycles, significantly delaying enemy volleys.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_3_desc: Deploys intelligent bio-projectiles that target critical reloading systems, creating cascading delays across enemy fleets.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_4_desc: Utilizes adaptive biological compounds that degrade reloading mechanisms, halving the firing efficiency of even the most advanced weaponry.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_5_desc: Fires advanced munitions that emit suppression fields, crippling enemy reloading systems and rendering them painfully slow.
text.tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_6_desc: Releases a biological pulse that locks down enemy reloading for extended periods.
text.tech_weaver_bio_confuser_1_desc: Organic projectiles imbued with destabilizing enzymes scramble enemy targeting systems and reduce their accuracy.
text.tech_weaver_bio_confuser_2_desc: Refined biological compounds disrupt targeting systems and short-range communications, sowing chaos among enemy ranks.
text.tech_weaver_bio_confuser_3_desc: Adaptive bio-munitions are deployed to exploit neural weaknesses in both organic and synthetic crews, crippling enemy efficiency.
text.tech_weaver_bio_confuser_4_desc: Intelligent bio-projectiles emit disruptive fields on impact, scrambling enemy targeting systems and causing widespread malfunctions.
text.tech_weaver_bio_confuser_5_desc: Advanced biological ordnance creates a cascading feedback loop within enemy systems, rendering their attacks wildly ineffective.
text.tech_weaver_bio_confuser_6_desc: Bio-electromagnetic pulses incapacitate targeting systems and leave fleets in a state of disarray.
text.tech_weaver_bio_evasion_1_desc: Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels.
text.tech_weaver_bio_evasion_2_desc: Releases concentrated bio-energetic fields, further boosting the evasion capabilities of our ships.
text.tech_weaver_bio_evasion_3_desc: Launches intelligent bio-projectiles that adaptively enhance agility, ensuring superior evasion even in the most chaotic battles.
text.tech_weaver_bio_evasion_4_desc: Deploys advanced munitions that generate dynamic bio-electric auras, significantly improving the ability of ships to evade enemy fire.
text.tech_weaver_bio_evasion_5_desc: Fires highly advanced projectiles that create large-scale enhancement fields, granting unparalleled evasion to fleets.
text.tech_weaver_bio_evasion_6_desc: Fires bio-munitions that emit fields of adaptive energy, allowing fleets to dance effortlessly out of harm's way.
text.tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_1_desc: Fires organic projectiles that emit energizing biofields, subtly increasing the firing speed of weapons systems.
text.tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_2_desc: Refined bio-munitions enhance biofield intensity, further accelerating the rate of fire.
text.tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_3_desc: Deploys adaptive bio-projectiles that amplify reaction times and system efficiency, enabling a significant increase in fire rate.
text.tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_4_desc: Generates dynamic bio-electric auras, vastly enhancing firing speed across multiple vessels, ensuring relentless pressure on enemy fleets.
text.tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_5_desc: Unleashes hyper-charged bio-munitions that create large-scale enhancement fields, enabling fleets to unleash sustained, rapid-fire barrages.
text.tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_6_desc: Projects waves of bio-energy that push our weaponry to their peak performance, flooding the battlefield with devastating firepower.
text.tech_weaver_bio_healing_1_desc: Regenerative pods are launched to deliver strong healing compounds to allied ships.
text.tech_weaver_bio_healing_2_desc: Highly efficient pods imbued with healing biomatter are deployed to rapidly repair damage across multiple vessels.
text.tech_weaver_bio_healing_3_desc: Pods containing repair agents are launched, optimizing healing based on the severity of damage and ensuring no vulnerabilities remain.
text.tech_weaver_bio_healing_4_desc: Pods that saturate the battlefield with adaptive spores provide smart healing to all allied vessels within range.
text.tech_weaver_bio_healing_5_desc: Deploys pods that unleash a wave of intelligent microorganisms, capable of revitalizing even the most damaged fleets.
text.tech_weaver_bio_healing_6_desc: Pods filled with malleable cells are launched to trigger the growth of new hull tissues, pushing the endurance of organic vessels beyond their former limits.
text.tech_weaver_build_speed_desc: These facilities nurture mid-sized biological ships within refined biopods, employing enhanced nutrient delivery and genetic optimization to produce agile and adaptable vessels for the fleet.
text.tech_weaver_growth_1_desc: These facilities employ enhanced bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth cycles and enhance vessel adaptability. Improved genetic matrices and optimized environments ensure these biological ships are both durable and highly responsive in combat.
text.tech_weaver_growth_2_desc: These facilities produce biological ships of unparalleled precision and versatility. Revolutionary growth techniques and adaptive genetic enhancements result in vessels that thrive in even the most demanding tactical scenarios.
text.tech_weavers_desc: Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities.
text.tech_wilderness_alloys_1_desc: Solid holographic casts can alter their shapes at a moment's notice, speeding up alloy production.
text.tech_wilderness_alloys_2_desc: Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.
text.tech_wilderness_cluster_desc: We can accelerate the fluency of global, collective thought by investing it in gatherings of symbionts whose sole purpose in life is to facilitate that same will.
text.tech_wilderness_colonial_centralization_: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.
text.tech_wilderness_confluence_desc: Our mutualistic will shall be strengthened by vast gatherings of deeply empathic symbionts, so in-tune with their surroundings as to concentrate and re-broadcast our collective thought.
text.tech_wilderness_defense_grid_desc: The strategic value of a good defense remains as relevant today as it was to our predecessors in the far distant past. Technology does not render fortifications obsolete - it merely changes their requirements.
text.tech_wilderness_exotic_gases_desc: Exotic Gas can be produced artificially, but it is a difficult process that requires advanced refinery equipment.
text.tech_wilderness_food_processing_1_desc: Improved food processing techniques will lead to better preservation methods and less spoilage.
text.tech_wilderness_food_processing_2_desc: New cryopreservation and protein resequencing methods will make food processing much more efficient.
text.tech_wilderness_galactic_administration_: The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.
text.tech_wilderness_government_desc: From the moment a new planet is awakened, its priorities must lie with asserting a stable and flourishing environment, more so than concern for our wider self.
text.tech_wilderness_industry_desc: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.
text.tech_wilderness_mineral_purification_1_d: Optimal processing of mined materials have allowed us to reach new levels of efficiency.
text.tech_wilderness_mineral_purification_2_d: Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.
text.tech_wilderness_node_desc: By encouraging the growth of deep-thinking symbionts in glades throughout our distributed self, our collective will shall be felt more keenly by all.
text.tech_wilderness_planetary_defenses_desc: There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready.
text.tech_wilderness_power_hub_1_desc: Load-balancing facilities can greatly improve the stability of local grids and feed excess power back into centralized capacitors.
text.tech_wilderness_power_hub_2_desc: A re-engineered and unified grid further reduces energy losses over distance.
text.tech_wilderness_rare_crystals_desc: The crystallization process is complicated and difficult, but synthetic crystals can be manufactured by using specialized industrial plants.
text.tech_wilderness_science_lab_2_desc: As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.
text.tech_wilderness_science_lab_3_desc: To expand our knowledge base, we must consider all levels of existence. A new realm of science awaits us!
text.tech_wilderness_shield_generator_desc: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.
text.tech_wilderness_terraform_desc: To spread our roots to a new world first requires us to prepare the seedbed. By first terraforming a planet we can ensure that our colonies are off to a healthy start.
text.tech_wilderness_volatile_motes_desc: Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.
text.tech_wormhole_stabilization_desc: A naturally occurring subspace wormhole is a fickle thing, and its fluctuating energy levels typically make it impossible to travel safely between its linked apertures. There are ways to temporarily stabilize its matrix, however.
text.tech_xeno_aesthetics_desc: After analyzing a multitude of artists from drastically different cultures, we have come up with a general theorem. By studying a civilization's art and culture, we can gain an advantage against them in combat.
text.tech_xeno_diplomacy_desc: Advancing our understanding of interactions with - and manipulations of - the xeno is a necessary step in forming more permanent interstellar alliances.
text.tech_xeno_linguistics_desc: Given recent encounters with intelligent races, it is essential that we improve our xeno-linguistic capabilities.
text.tech_xeno_relations_desc: The complexities of interstellar diplomacy necessitate the forming of bonds with foreign powers in order to further one's goals.
text.tech_xeno_tourism_agency_desc: This corporate agency promotes a wide variety of interstellar tourist attractions, as well as offering employment packages and signing bonuses to potential emigrants interested in relocating to corporate space.
text.tech_zero_point_power_desc: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.
text.tech_zro_launcher_desc: These highly concentrated pellets of zro can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.
